contents.name: Segre–Veronese proof
contents.reason: The full projective-space result is included by its direct coordinate proof; importing the alternative embedding route would require scheme-level Segre and Veronese machinery not used in this pair.

contents.name: Variety convention
contents.reason: This text allows reducible varieties; the existing library uses its own convention. Do not replace that definition while scaffolding separation properties of arbitrary schemes.

contents.name: Irreducibility of products
contents.reason: This belongs to geometric irreducibility over fields and needs precise field hypotheses; it is not used for separatedness and is not imported with an implicit algebraic-closure convention.

contents.name: Analytification
contents.reason: Complex analytic comparison is outside this pair of scheme-theoretic diagonal and valuation results, and supplies no logical prerequisite here.

contents.name: Noetherian schemes have quasi-separated morphisms
contents.reason: Noetherian automatic quasi-separatedness is a supplementary simplification, not used in the general criterion proved with quasi-separatedness explicitly assumed.

contents.name: Quasiprojective and finite consequences
contents.reason: These applications need the finite and quasiprojective morphism definitions assigned to the immediately following pair. The separation permanence needed there is retained here.

contents.name: Cancellation for a general property P
contents.reason: The separation and quasi-compact cancellation cases are included here; the general metatheorem for arbitrary properties is reserved for the next morphism-properties pair.
